dedupe_keys.name: usgs national wwtp nutrient load data from the epa clean watersheds needs survey 1978 2012

description: This USGS data release, produced by the National Water Quality Assessment Project, turns thirteen rounds of the EPA Clean Watersheds Needs Survey (1978 to 2012) into a facility-level table of wastewater treatment plant flows and nutrient loads. For each facility and survey year it holds the CWNS facility information, the reported annual effluent flow and treatment level, and total nitrogen and total phosphorus loads calculated from the flow and literature concentrations for raw, primary, secondary and advanced treatment. Coverage is the facilities reported to the CWNS across the United States. The CSV (27 MB) and FGDC metadata are a free download from ScienceBase as a USGS data release (doi:10.5066/F7MG7MNN), described in Scientific Investigations Report 2017-5115. Caveats: concentrations are literature values substituted for the treatment level, not measurements, and gaps in flow and treatment level are filled by linear assumptions between survey years. Simulation uses: a long record of plant flows and treatment levels per facility for capacity planning of wastewater treatment and for load scenarios under climate adaptation. Related records: the EPA Clean Watersheds Needs Survey 2022 (data-epa-clean-watersheds-needs-survey-2022).
